note: Race weekend roundups — UK performances per event, coach-voice takes. Newest first. Items dated in the future auto-publish on their date.

highlights: Crew took 14 athletes to ExCeL — six PBs, two first podiums in age groups
Mixed doubles pair went 1:02:31 — fastest crew time of the season
items.take: London does what London does — loud, warm and unforgiving on the wall balls. The crew handled it better than the heat handled us. Six PBs isn't luck, it's twelve weeks of boring Tuesdays.

highlights: First-timer cohort all finished under 1:45 — nobody died
Three athletes booked Birmingham on the back of their first sim in July
items.take: This is the funnel working: sim in July, race in August, addicted by September. Watch the same faces turn up to the next one.

highlights: Travel crew took the train up together — nine athletes, one carriage
Sled pull PBs across the board — the rope work paid off
items.take: The train carriage version of a race weekend is the product. Nine people who met at a sim, sharing a carriage, arguing about splits the whole way up. HYROX is the excuse.
